title: Caption Source Check
user: A viewer or event volunteer who needs to know whether a live stream has an official usable caption track and a clean way to follow that track outside a cluttered player.

evidence.quote_or_summary: The asker wants a simple live-updated transcript for NASA communications and reports that obtaining the existing high-quality YouTube subtitles is difficult.
A transcript feature request identifies missing captions as a failure case and asks for a local fallback, evidence that caption availability is still unreliable.

smallest_useful_product: A browser extension that reports whether the current page exposes an official caption track, its language/type and live status, then presents that user-visible track in a simple large-text pane.
constraints: Read only page/player data the browser already makes available; comply with host terms; no content retention; clearly distinguish machine-generated from human captions when metadata exists.
